title: The Cover of Geneva Revisited
author: Marguerite Ishikawa
blurb: Orsen Eriksen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
